claims_upheld: A live PNet Network Engineering agency advert for the recorded title/location/reference was retrievable on 2026-10-06.
Network Engineering is an official Network Recruitment engineering division.
The role requirements and any displayed pay were transcribed from the direct listing, not inferred from company characteristics.
claims_downgraded: A live PNet page does not confirm the end employer still accepts applications.
Agency advertiser identity is not end-employer identity.
The direct PNet detail page shows a R1,000,000 package value, but the pay period is not stated; annual-threshold qualification remains VERIFY.
